convention.name: trackLayout
convention.meaning: Layout and scrollbar presentation of a carousel scrolling track.
convention.whenToUse: Choose the default padded track or a full-width track with a visually hidden scrollbar while retaining native scrolling.
convention.avoid: Do not use for arbitrary element width, visual treatment or a non-scrolling content row.
